title: The leak scan closes its four known misses: PGP key blocks, escaped and prefixed EC keys, and a stale scan cache
goal: The leak scan flags a PGP private key block whose armor line ends in PRIVATE KEY BLOCK and is followed by key material; the leak scan flags an EC private key whose line breaks are written as a doubled backslash and n; the leak scan flags an EC private key whose lines carry a Markdown quote, a # or // comment prefix, or share a table row; the publish scan's cache key changes with every kbcommon.SECRETS shape, so no verdict cached under an old shape is read
